function.name: announce
function.description: Speak ONE in-fiction line to every player. Use for world mood, omens, weather, alarm, rumor. One short sentence.

text.description: The line itself, plain in-fiction prose, at most 200 characters, no quotation marks around it.

function.name: spawn_enemies
function.description: Raise ONE hostile band at the frontier (the edge of explored land). The game picks the exact tile. Use when the map's edge should feel dangerous.

count.description: Band size, 1 to 4 follows. 2 is a fair cull.

level.description: Band strength, 1 to 3. 1 is the safe edge; 3 is trouble.

function.name: raise_village
function.description: Found ONE new settlement exactly at the frontier (the dark edge of the map). It arrives with an innkeeper, a storekeep, and a villager — real, walkable, tradeable.

name.description: The settlement's name, one or two words, at most 32 characters, e.g. "Slagmoor" or "Drover's Rest".
